sets_description: Five distinct Birdcast sets for podcasts, interviews, branded conversations and founder content.

set_2_short: A casual, polished setup for relaxed or business talks.
set_2_description: The Ciera set combines a chill, casual vibe with a sleek, professional design, making it equally perfect for relaxed chats and serious business conversations.
set_3_short: Clean lines and warm tones for approachable conversations.
set_3_description: The Contemporary set is minimalistic and inviting, with clean lines and warm tones that create the perfect space for meaningful, approachable conversations.
set_4_short: A futuristic blue-lit set for bold, cinematic episodes.
set_4_description: The Tron set brings a cinematic, futuristic atmosphere with sharp blue lighting, strong contrast and a high-tech visual mood. It is ideal for bold interviews, tech conversations and visually distinctive podcast episodes.
set_5_short: A bright, soft-toned set for warm and calm conversations.
set_5_description: The Kumo set uses soft tones, warm lighting and a clean welcoming atmosphere. It works well for lifestyle conversations, personal brands, coaching content and approachable founder interviews.

founder_title: Baligh Mhanna - From BBC Newsnight to Your Podcast
founder_paragraph_1: Before Birdcast, Baligh spent nearly three decades inside the rooms where the world’s biggest news and broadcast shows were made - across the BBC, CNN, Sky News, Sky Sports, Cartoon Network and Bloomberg.
founder_paragraph_2: Today, that same broadcast instinct sits behind every Birdcast session: when to hold a shot, when to cut, when to let silence breathe, and how to make the whole production feel intentional.
founder_quote: We built this space so serious creators can just walk in, sit down, and speak. We handle the rest at a global broadcast standard.
